subject: Re: MAP: POC Environment - Org & Network Setup
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ramos <elena.ramos@medsys.com>, Sam Huang <sam.huang@acmetech.io>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T09:02:00-08:00
Subject: MAP: POC Environment - Org & Network Setup

Hi Elena and Sam,

Thanks again for the time on Friday — attaching the first-draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) for the MedSys evaluation. I pulled together a focused runbook for the POC environment so we can lock the activation window. High-level ask: can you confirm ownership for procurement and networking so we can schedule the VPC peering and IP allowlist change?

Key deliverables in this MAP:
- Org setup: Create an org under your account with the name "MedSys-Redwood-POC"; add two service users we’ll provide (svc-redwood-1, svc-redwood-2).
- API keys: We'll ship scoped API keys once org is created; keys will be tied to the POC org and rotate at end of POC.
- IP allowlist: We need a CIDR block (or single IP) added to the MedSys firewall: 34.208.12.64/28 (Redwood egress).
- VPC peering: Two-step: (1) confirm VPC and subnet details on your side, (2) accept peering request during the scheduled maintenance window.

Proposed timeline (flexible):
1) Org & service accounts created — target by 2026-11-03
2) API keys issued & smoke test — 2026-11-04
3) IP allowlist & peering window — 2026-11-07 (4-hour window, AM preferred)

Attached: MAP_MedSys_v1.pdf (action items table), network_diagram_v2.png (peering topology).

Next steps for you:
- Elena: confirm who on your side will own the peering (network lead) and procurement contact for the short-term evaluation contract.
- Sam: confirm whether your team needs an internal change ticket template for the firewall.

If that timeline looks okay I’ll send calendar invites and open the peering request on our side.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0193

Attachments:
- MAP_MedSys_v1.pdf (PDF, 62KB)
- network_diagram_v2.png (PNG, 430KB)

From: Elena Ramos <elena.ramos@medsys.com>

Date: 2026-11-02T10:18:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP: POC Environment - Org & Network Setup

Hi Marissa,

Appreciate the clear plan and the attachments — helpful. A couple quick clarifications from our side:

- Procurement: forwarding to procure@medsys.com; they’ll need the short-term SOW and billing cadence.
- Network: I’ll own the peering coordination internally; our network lead is Samir Patel (samir.patel@medsys.com) — copying separately in a follow-up.
- IP allowlist: We can add the /28 block but we’ll need the exact egress IPs from Redwood the day before change for verification.

Question: Are the scoped API keys you mention bearer tokens tied to a single service account? We prefer service-account-based creds so we can audit.

I’ll confirm procurement ETA today. For the peering window, mornings next week (11/07 or 11/08) work for us.

Thanks,

Elena Ramos
Director of Integrations
MedSys Health
elena.ramos@medsys.com

Elena — thanks for the quick reply. A few operational notes from our side so we can reduce back-and-forth when procurement and network are ready:

- API keys: yes — we will create keys scoped to the service accounts (svc-redwood-1 and svc-redwood-2). Each key is trackable in our audit logs and we’ll provide a key ID mapping document. We’ll also publish a short runbook on key rotation during the POC.
- Egress IPs: we will provide the final IPs (or NAT prefix) 24 hours before the allowlist change. If your infra requires IP-by-IP confirmation we can send the full list then.
- Peering: suggest a tentative 4-hour window on 2026-11-07 09:00–13:00 PST. We will request peering from our cloud account immediately after you confirm VPC/subnet IDs.

Operational assignments (internal):
- Marissa: calendar invites + MAP finalization
- Kimberly: open peering request and track acceptance
- Sean: prepare short SOW snippet for procurement (30-day eval, usage limits)

Elena, Sam — if that aligns we’ll push invites this afternoon.

Best,

Jonas Weber
Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference

Thanks everyone — we’re good to proceed. A few confirmations from my team:

- Procurement: I’ve looped AcmeTech’s billing team for a short-term MSA addendum to cover the integration work and usage during the evaluation; they’ll coordinate with MedSys procurement.
- Network details: MedSys to share VPC id and peering CIDR; Samir (Elena’s network lead) asked for the peering request in the following format (VPC ID, subnet range, account/project ID).
- Window: 2026-11-07 09:00–13:00 PST is fine for us. We’ll stage our endpoint and validate post-peering.

Marissa — please send the 15-min checklist we’ll run the morning of the window (egress IP check, key smoke test, healthcheck URL). I’ll coordinate our side’s change ticket.

Sam Huang
